svg.text: A working foundation for Otto. Quiet surfaces, precise type, and one blue accent
reserved for action and focus, so people and agents can share work without noise.
Blue marks the primary action, the focus ring and a running Run. Nothing else.
Ink on Canvas 16.97:1 · Stone on Canvas 4.63:1

svg.text: A task, a conversation, a result.
Cody finished a Run and proposed the fix. Johan decides when the task is done.
A 4-point rhythm. Flat by default, raised only when floating.
36 px height · 8 px radius · 2 px focus ring with a 2 px gap
Icon buttons always carry an accessible name. The tooltip appears on hover and on keyboard focus.
Clear labels, visible focus, specific feedback.
Visible to everyone in this project.
Press Enter to create the task.
Add a title to create the task.
A finished Run never completes a task by itself.
Patterns, not screens. One rail, floating cards, an open canvas.
Icon rail, screen-specific context card, open canvas,
Every icon is named. The card shows this screen's
filters, never a second copy of the rail.

g.text: Fix is up for review. Done is your call.
